instruction_completeness_test.reasoning: Instruction alone does not say to ignore the touch list, drop vanished rows, or match origin path.

discovery_budget.discovery: Atlas rebuild merges a touch list and keeps prior symbol spans and vanished paths.
Clip lookup takes the first matching symbol row and falls back with stale ranges.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Neighbour body, green reknit, public origin and fail-on-missing; no merge recipe.

attack_path.reasoning: Trap is last-row; tests add twin helper dumps and hide-origin.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: Rewrite atlas from live srcbeds with fresh spans, look up by origin path, fail reknit when dump origins or rows are missing.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Three coordinated C changes plus rebuild; not last-row pick.

collapse_audit.reasoning: Residual work is incremental index invalidation plus origin-qualified lookup.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: Models that pick the last symbol row still fail twin helper dumps.

topology_enumeration.summary: Scan rewrites all units; pick matches origin; gap checks dumps and rows.
